title: Google Health Takeout export (raw, parsed rows)
description: The subset of a Google Health Takeout export that packages/connectors/src/providers/google-health reads, as rows straight off the CSV/JSON split — field names are Google/Fitbit's, not ours. This is the Takeout dialect of the google_health_connect platform: per-signal CSVs plus month-sliced JSON, NOT Health Connect record types, and not a Garmin export even when every value arrived by Garmin sync (observed: zero filename overlap with a real Garmin export; every heart-rate row labelled 'Garmin Connect™ Health Kit'). Every field is optional because the export is full of holes and hollow files: measured over one real 480-file export, daily resting HR covered 47/120 days, sleep 2 nights, and the Fitbit composites (sleep_score.csv, Stress Score.csv) were header-only because Garmin-synced values never get scored by Fitbit. 0 and UNSPECIFIED are not-measured sentinels throughout.

dailyRestingHeartRate.description: Rows of Physical Activity_GoogleData/daily_resting_heart_rate.csv. One row per measured day — absent days are simply absent.

timestamp.description: Local midnight expressed as a UTC instant (2026-03-31T16:00:00Z = 00:00 +08:00 on 2026-04-01). The UTC date is the wrong day for any athlete east of Greenwich; the time-of-day encodes the offset.

beats per minute.description: Float in the file ('59.0'). 0 is the not-measured sentinel, not a heart rate.

data source.description: Recorder label, e.g. 'Garmin Connect™ Health Kit'. Provenance of the value, not the dialect.

restingHeartRateMonthly.description: Entries of Global Export Data/resting_heart_rate-*.json — the second spelling of the same daily fact. Both spellings must normalize identically.

dateTime.description: US month-first, two-digit year, no zone: '04/06/26 00:00:00'.

value.description: 0.0 is the not-measured sentinel — the observed export is wall-to-wall 0.0 here while the CSV spelling carries the real values.

steps.description: Rows of Physical Activity_GoogleData/steps_*.csv (month-sliced): intra-day intervals, true UTC instants. The same hours of the same day arrive from more than one recorder ('Garmin Connect™ Health Kit' and 'Phone Health Kit'); summing every row double-counts the day.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC instant, sometimes with fractional seconds.

exercises.description: Rows of Health Fitness Data_GoogleData/UserExercises_*.csv (46 columns; only the ones read are contracted). tracker_* and manually_logged_* are parallel blocks; observed Garmin-synced sessions land as log_type MANUAL with the tracker_* block populated.

utc_offset.description: The session's local offset, e.g. '+08:00' — carried in-row, unlike Strava's export.

log_type.description: MANUAL / TRACKER / AUTO_DETECTED. Garmin-synced sessions arrive as MANUAL.

tracker_total_calories.description: Active energy for the session. 0 means not measured.

tracker_cardio_load.description: Fitbit's own training-load composite (Cardio Load). 0 means Fitbit never computed it — true of every Garmin-synced session observed. When present it is the vendor's load and is used as-is, not recomputed.

sleeps.description: Rows of Health Fitness Data_GoogleData/UserSleeps_*.csv. Minutes-denominated where Health Connect speaks stage seconds. No main-sleep flag survives into this export, so a nap is indistinguishable from a night except by duration — every row is emitted.

sleep_type.description: STAGES or CLASSIC — two recorders of the same fact.

sleep_end.description: UTC instant. With end_utc_offset this yields the local wake-up day the night belongs to.

sleepScores.description: Rows of Sleep Score/sleep_score.csv — Fitbit's overnight composite. Header-only in the observed export: Fitbit does not score Garmin-synced nights. Contracted from the header plus Fitbit's published takeout format.

resting_heart_rate.description: Present in the file but not mapped — daily_resting_heart_rate.csv is the resting-HR source; mapping both would double-emit the same day.

stressScores.description: Rows of Stress Score/Stress Score.csv — Fitbit's stress composite. Header-only in the observed export for the same Garmin-sync reason.

STRESS_SCORE.description: 0-100. 0 alongside CALCULATION_FAILED means Fitbit gave up, not that the athlete was serene.

CALCULATION_FAILED.description: When true the row's score is not evidence.
